scope: Exposed descriptive queries, no confirmatory p-values, normalization, sound or name fit.
oal: Count exact token, proper initial (longer than oal), noninitial (any start index>0 including word-final), anywhere union. Preserve every reading separately and all source alternatives. Section metadata already combines Astronomy/Astrology.
seam: Split first alch into pre+al | ch+tail. Record standalone component frequencies without adopting boundaries. Compare tail token frequency distributions against ordinary initial-ch word tails, including empty tails.
metric: Explicit descriptive distribution overlap=sum min(p,q)=1-total variation. Quoted0.68 definition unavailable, so this cannot be called an exact replication of that metric. Also reweight ordinary-ch pools to alch section+hand+format strata; report missing strata.
boundary: Record adjacent complete words left ending al and right starting ch within each original row, no cross-unknown or cross-row joining. At joined-alch source loci look for exact candidate left,right in alternate source rows; retain full contexts because position alignment is not guaranteed.
limits: A common component does not disprove a restricted combination; shared endings do not establish a word boundary or root. Counts cannot select Pleiades or a lunar mansion. All g,m,y remain separate. No old frozen experiment changed.
provenance: A concurrently written oal-seam-audit-v92 folder was encountered; this isolated audit has its own script, frozen rules, input hash and records. No further edits to that folder.
